follow-up time: From the first trimester (11-14 weeks) to the third trimester (32-35 weeks) of pregnancy
outcome: Changes in uterine scar thickness during pregnancy
Low uterine segment (LUS) myometrial thickness changes between the second and third trimesters
cohort: 122 pregnant women aged 18-41 years with at least one previous cesarean delivery
finding: Cesarean scar myometrial thickness decreases throughout pregnancy, and the presence of a cesarean scar niche is associated with a more significant decrease in LUS myometrial thickness between the second and third trimesters.
mod_finding: This study focuses on uterine scar thickness after cesarean delivery and does not directly investigate the impact of mode of delivery on other outcomes.
gest_age: First trimester (11-14 weeks) to third trimester (32-35 weeks)
